mapper.update: UPDATE t_activity SET title=#{dto.title},description=#{dto.description},starts_at=#{dto.startsAt}, ends_at=#{dto.endsAt},capacity=#{dto.capacity},remaining=#{dto.capacity},update_time= WHERE id=#{id} AND starts_at > AND pending_count=0 AND #{dto.startsAt} > AND #{dto.endsAt} > #{dto.startsAt}
UPDATE t_activity SET status='PUBLISHED',update_time= WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT' AND starts_at >
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_activity WHERE status='PUBLISHED'
SELECT * FROM t_activity_registration WHERE request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_activity_registration WHERE activity_id=#{activityId} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_activity_registration WHERE activity_id=#{activityId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM t_activity_registration WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND status='PENDING' AND dispatch_token=#{token} FOR UPDATE

SELECT request_id,activity_id,status,create_time,update_time,dispatch_attempts,failure_count, CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN next_dispatch_at END AS next_dispatch_at, CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND last_error IS NOT NULL THEN '确认事务失败或结果未知，按当前状态恢复' END AS failure_summary FROM t_activity_registration WHERE activity_id=#{activityId} AND status=#{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC,request_id LIMIT #{offset},#{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_activity_registration WHERE activity_id=#{activityId} AND status=#{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_activity SET pending_count=pending_count+1,update_time= WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND starts_at <= AND ends_at > AND pending_count < 1000
UPDATE t_activity SET pending_count=pending_count-1,update_time= WHERE id=#{id} AND pending_count > 0
UPDATE t_activity SET remaining=remaining-1,pending_count=pending_count-1,update_time= WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND remaining > 0 AND pending_count > 0
UPDATE t_activity SET remaining=remaining+1,update_time= WHERE id=#{id} AND remaining < capacity

UPDATE t_activity_registration SET dispatch_token=COALESCE(dispatch_token,#{token}), next_dispatch_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,LEAST(300,30*POW(2,LEAST(dispatch_attempts,4))),), dispatch_attempts=LEAST(dispatch_attempts+1,2147483647),update_time= WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND status='PENDING' AND next_dispatch_at <=

UPDATE t_activity_registration SET failure_count=failure_count+1, status=CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,dispatch_token=NULL, next_dispatch_at=CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, LEAST(300,30*POW(2,LEAST(failure_count,4))),) END, last_error='确认事务失败或结果未知，按当前状态恢复',update_time= WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND status='PENDING' AND dispatch_token=#{token}
UPDATE t_activity SET pending_count=pending_count+1,update_time= WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND pending_count < 1000

UPDATE t_activity_registration SET status='PENDING',failure_count=0,dispatch_attempts=0, dispatch_token=NULL,next_dispatch_at=,last_error=NULL,update_time= WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND status='FAILED'
